enrollment: 24 fresh development problems; all ineligible cases retained without replacement. No v1 test reuse.
comparison: Common candidate pool, all selector choices saved before downstream outcomes. Continue receives full remaining generator budget; every branch is charged the entire pool, including discarded candidates. Local selector generation/prefill/time are additionally recorded, not hidden inside a claim of total-compute matching. Jev uses identical observable task/history/candidate text and a Choice primitive; probability is not a causal value. Jev latency/input usage/USD are additional acquisition costs.
fallback: Missing cheap scores select first; invalid local or Jev selects likelihood. No hosted retry. Failed requests retain conservative reservations.
limitations: Entropy-reduction ranking is a GUARD-inspired component, not a full published-method reproduction. Same generator backbone supplies local judging; it is not the gold verifier. Two continuations cannot identify a reliable oracle action.
transition: Audit all outcomes; primary exploratory contrasts Jev-minus-likelihood and Jev-minus-local. No winner promotion on this development sample. Fresh prospective design required.
